user.title: Pilote Solaire — Setup
user.description: What type of installation do you have?

equipment.title: Pilote Solaire — Equipment
equipment.description: Select the hardware you use. The plugin will automatically find the right sensors.

entities.title: Pilote Solaire — Detected sensors
entities.description: Review the automatically detected sensors. You can adjust them if needed.

data_description.grid_entity: Grid power — positive = import, negative = export (e.g. sensor.whatwatt_go_power_in)
data_description.production_entity: Power produced by your panels (e.g. sensor.fronius_power)
data_description.consumption_entity: Total house consumption (optional, calculated if absent)

api.title: Pilote Solaire — Connection
api.description: Enter your API key provided by Romande Dynamics.

data_description.api_key: Your personal API key (received by email)
data_description.update_interval: Data sending frequency in minutes (15 min recommended)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Pilote Solaire
reconfigure.description: Modify your integration settings. Advanced fields (meters, polarity, HA) are optional.

data_description.grid_entity: Grid power — positive = import, negative = export
data_description.grid_import_positive: Uncheck if your grid sensor is inverted (positive = export)
data_description.battery_entity: Alternative to separate charge/discharge — single entity with signed value (+ charge, - discharge)
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Uncheck if your battery sensor is inverted
data_description.meter_production: Cumulative kWh counter — takes priority over power sensor if set
data_description.meter_import: Cumulative kWh grid import counter — takes priority over grid sensor if set
data_description.meter_export: Cumulative kWh grid export counter — takes priority over grid sensor if set
data_description.update_interval: Data sending frequency in minutes (15 min recommended)
data_description.ha_url: External HA URL (optional, for live API)
data_description.ha_token: HA long-lived access token (optional, for live API)

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

data_description.consumer_entity: Consumer power sensor (e.g. EV charger, heat pump, pool…)
data_description.consumer_name: Name that will appear in the cockpit chart
